headline: UK Universities York, Liverpool, Bristol to open India Campuses; CMS INDUSLAW Advises
sum: CMS INDUSLAW advised Erulearning Solutions Private Limited on the establishment of three campuses in India for the University of York, the University of Liverpool and the University of Bristol through separate joint venture arrangements.…
detail: CMS INDUSLAW advised Erulearning Solutions Private Limited on the establishment of three campuses in India for the University of York, the University of Liverpool and the University of Bristol through separate joint venture arrangements. The Firm also advised on the lease arrangements for the campus properties in connection with the establishment of the campuses. The CMS INDUSLAW team comprised: Corporate team: Saurav Kumar (Partner), Ayusha Choudhury (Senior Associate), Associates Aryan Dhingra, Kaustubh Garg and Vartika Jain. Real Estate team: Gautam Kumar Bhargava (Partner), Kartik Madaan (Associate).
